newsitem.title: USA: Ergo Science names Abrahams chairman/CEO.
newsitem.headline: Ergo Science names Abrahams chairman/CEO.

text.p: Ergo Science Corp Thursday said President and acting Chief Executive Ronald Abrahams was named chairman and chief executive.
The board also appointed Anthony Cincotta, chief scientific officer, to executive vice president. He is a founder and has been a director since 1990.

Manuel Cincotta retired as chairman and as a director and officer of the biopharmaceutical company. Cincotta, along with Cincotta, is a founder and served as chief executive until September 1995 when he retired for health reasons.
